records.name: Wolfram Language 15
records.tagline: Computational language built for humans and AI agents
records.description: New and updated functionality in Wolfram Language 15: LLM & AI, notebook & user interfaces, symbolic & numeric computations, visualization & graphics, geometry & graphs, astronomy, chemistry, life sciences, knowledgebase, video, PDEs & system modeling, core language, compiler & evaluation, repositories.

records.name: BrainFlow
records.tagline: Turn your rambling thoughts into coherent notes
records.description: Tap record, say what's on your mind, and get back a real note: clean headings, key points, next steps. No typing, no tidying. Export to Notion or email to yourself.

records.name: Polygram Coding Agent
records.tagline: AI-native coding assistant that helps developers in any IDE
records.description: Polygram IDE Agent is an AI-native coding assistant that helps developers plan, design, code, and edit products directly inside their IDE. Unlike traditional coding assistants, Polygram uses intelligent multi-agent workflows and smart model routing to dynamically select the best AI models and agents for maximum token efficiency, speed, and output quality. It plugs directly into VS Code, Cursor, and Antigravity along with visual editor for frontend developers.

records.name: Android 17
records.tagline: Android becomes an intelligence system
records.description: Android 17 brings AppFunctions, Android MCP, adaptive-first app requirements, App Bubbles, Continue On, stronger privacy controls, memory limits, performance improvements, and new media/camera APIs as Android starts shifting from an operating system into an intelligence system.

records.name: memi
records.tagline: The AI agent harness for product design teams
records.description: A macOS workbench where Claude, Codex, and Hermes run on your specs, research, and Figma files.

records.name: StickerWords
records.tagline: Learn new words from the world around you
records.description: StickerWords turns the world around you into a language lesson. Snap an object, food, sign, or anything nearby, and instantly learn its word in your target language. Each word is saved to your personal vocabulary list with example sentences and spaced repetition reviews, so you don’t just learn it once. You actually remember it!

records.name: Cilantro
records.tagline: Watches your accounts and tells you what changed
records.description: Connect your bank accounts once and Cilantro does the watching - odd charges, bill creep, auto-detected trip recaps, and a weekly "here's what changed." No budgets, no tagging. Works solo, better with a partner. Read-only, no ads, no data sales.

records.name: ClipDone
records.tagline: Automatic short-form video editing
records.description: Creating video content still takes too much work. The best marketing videos usually come from real people speaking to a camera, but manual editing is slow and expensive. It shouldn’t be easier to generate AI videos than to edit real ones. That’s why we built ClipDone. It automatically turns your raw footage into ready-to-post shorts. Just upload your footage and ClipDone edits it together, adds subtitles, b-roll, and animations.

records.name: Henji
records.tagline: AI replies that are trained to sound like you
records.description: Henji turns your half-formed thoughts into a finished reply that sounds like you — not a generic AI. Most AI tools think for you and hand back text in their voice, so you rewrite it anyway. Henji is the opposite: you keep the thinking, Henji just handles the writing. Select a message, drop a few keywords, and get a reply in your tone — ready to send. The more you use it, the more it learns your phrasing, your rhythm, your emoji habits. Starts with Slack. Built for anyone drowning in replies.

records.name: SuperGoal
records.tagline: World cup in your menu bar
records.description: The little Mac app that keeps World Cup 2026 in your menu bar. Live scores, every fixture, groups and your favorite teams, and custom themes.

records.name: AudienceCue
records.tagline: Turn YouTube comments into cited insights and a report
records.description: Download every comment from any YouTube video, channel, or playlist, then turn them into an AI report — audience signals, sentiment, and content ideas. Every insight links back to a real public comment you can verify. Free to start.

records.name: Dopami
records.tagline: Household chores without the mental load for ADHD
records.description: Dopami helps ADHD families, adults, and roommates handle household chores without mental load by suggesting small missions based on room, time, energy, and shared home context.

records.name: MCP 2000
records.tagline: AI Drum Machine MPC in your browser
records.description: MCP2000 is an AI-powered MPC that lives in your browser. Type what you want to hear ("dusty boom bap kit with crunchy snares," "8-bar afro-house shaker loop at 120 BPM") and it generates the samples, drops them onto a 4x4 pad grid, and lets you finger-drum, chop, sequence, and add effects. No crate-digging, no plugins, no install. Just prompt, play, and build a beat.

records.name: Restaurant Menu Visualizer
records.tagline: Share the menu with Ava and see what each dish may look like
records.description: Sometimes you go to a restaurant, take a seat at the table, start reading the menu and then... "What even is this? Too many French terms. I don’t even know what I should order." You’ve been there, right? That’s why I built this feature, so Ava could show me what a dish may look like, without asking the waiter. Ava is not fully baked yet, so when you talk to her, she may say stupid things. It's all part of growing up.

records.name: NotchSpace
records.tagline: Turn your Mac notch into an intelligent active workspace
records.description: NotchSpace turns the Mac notch into a controllable workspace layer. It has three core features: a quick app launcher for instant access, a menu bar manager to clean and rearrange your top bar, and a temporary workspace for dragging and moving files, text, links, and colors between apps. Everything is intentional—you choose what enters the space. No auto-capture. Built natively for macOS with SwiftUI. Fully local, no tracking or uploads.

records.name: Tapfree for Chrome
records.tagline: Voice dictation that adapts to what’s on your screen
records.description: Typing on the web has not evolved. Tapfree fixes that. Tapfree is a voice-first keyboard for Chrome text fields and ChromeOS that lets you write messages, notes, docs, and emails by speaking naturally - without dictation errors, awkward formatting, or constant corrections. It understands context, not just words.

records.name: Spanly
records.tagline: See what AI agents do inside your MCP server
records.description: Soon, more agents than humans will use your product via MCP. Spanly gives you full observability on the MCP server you ship: error rates, session traces, latency, client analytics, deploy alerts. Drop-in CLI or SDK. US & EU data residency. Built for SaaS engineering teams shipping MCP in production, alongside the Datadog, Sentry, or New Relic you already run.

records.name: Deep Work Plan
records.tagline: Models matter. Context matters more. Give your agent a plan.
records.description: Deep Work Plan turns any repo into a harness with the context of your best engineer — so any AI agent codes like your smartest model and can't drift from the plan. Not a chat window it forgets, a spec written into the repo: atomic tasks, acceptance criteria, validation gates, resumable state. Long runs survive context resets; any agent picks up where the last left off. Point an agent at it, walk away, come back to work you can verify. Any agent, any repo, no lock-in. Open Source, MIT.

records.name: Mirlo
records.tagline: Social media for real connections. No likes, no algorithm.
records.description: Mirlo is a European social app for real human connection. Built without engagement hooks: no likes, no public comments, no algorithm, no infinite scroll. Mutual connections only, so the conversation stays between the people in it. Hosted in the EU, no ads, no data sold. Subscription-only, 14-day trial. On iOS across 30 EU countries with wider rollout planned. Made for the people who quietly closed the apps that stopped working for them.

records.name: Locus Founder
records.tagline: Text an AI agent and it builds + runs your business
records.description: Locus Founder builds and runs a whole business for you. Most AI tools only build you a landing page, Locus Founder interviews you, designs the brand, and ships a full-stack app. Locus Founder doesn't stop there; it sets up Stripe payments, sources your product, creates and publishes ads, and so much more. Locus Founder is always working in the background and pings you to approve any decisions or spending. No templates, no forms, no code. Locus Founder is backed by YCombinator.

records.name: Dualora
records.tagline: Record in both 16:9 and 9:16 at the same time
records.description: Multi-platform creators have a broken workflow: record landscape for YouTube, flip the phone, record again for Shorts. Or record once and spend 20 minutes cropping a second version that still looks off. Dualora fixes this at capture time — not in post. Open the app and you see both 16:9 and 9:16 framing live on screen while you shoot — Split View or Picture-in-Picture. Hit record. Export two files. Upload to two platforms. Done. No guessing. No re-shooting. No desktop detour. No Account.

records.name: Quartz
records.tagline: AI email client built for focus. Runs locally on your Mac
records.description: Quartz turns Gmail into a focused inbox. It sorts every message by importance, and learns what matters to you over time. When you reply, it drafts in your own voice. And the AI runs entirely on your own Mac, so your mail stays end-to-end encrypted and never shared with AI providers.

records.name: Swytchcode CLI
records.tagline: Give agents reliable access to 2,000+ APIs w/ durable state
records.description: Write agent logic, and skip the plumbing. Give AI agents reliable access to 2,000+ APIs with retries, idempotency, policy enforcement, and durable state.

records.name: Framer 3.0
records.tagline: With Agents, Branching, Community, and an all-new design
records.description: Agents bring AI to the canvas to help you design, write, analyze, and organize your sites. We’re also launching Branching, a new way for teams to explore ideas before they go live, and unveiling the new Framer Community, where creators can share and earn. Together, these launches change how teams create, maintain, and scale websites. We think you’ll love it.

records.name: Wario Synth
records.tagline: Transform songs into retro Gameboy-style game console music
records.description: Wario.Style turns any song into a Game Boy-style chiptune, right in your browser. Type a song title and it searches BitMidi for the MIDI, then synthesizes it live through four authentic chiptune channels: two pulse, one wave, one noise. No signup, no server render. Export as WAV or MIDI and share with a link that previews the track. The catalogue runs deep on classics, so throw it something timeless. Can't find it? Upload your own MIDI and hear it in 8-bit.

records.name: Snapchat SPECS
records.tagline: Powerful computer built into lightweight see-through glasses
records.description: SPECS bring computing into the world around you, so you can learn, work, and play while staying present in the moment.

records.name: SolonGate
records.tagline: Zero-trust security gateway for AI agents
records.description: AI agents don't just chat anymore; they execute. SolonGate is the zero-trust security layer that controls exactly what your autonomous AI agents can do. We sit directly between LLMs and your internal systems, APIs, or databases. Every action your AI attempts is filtered through our deterministic Policy Engine and an isolated AI Judge. We block risky, unauthorized, or destructive actions before execution. Complete action governance.

records.name: PaneFlow
records.tagline: Let AI agents build real animated slideshows
records.description: PaneFlow now ships an MCP server, so AI agents like Claude and Cursor build real animated slideshows for you - laid out, on-brand, and exportable to code, video, or PDF. Every result is a real, editable project you own. Plus a rebuilt editor and 50 new templates.

records.name: idmly
records.tagline: Turn any HTML/CSS design into an editable InDesign file
records.description: idmly converts a self-contained HTML/CSS design into a native, editable Adobe InDesign file. Real text frames, named paragraph styles, charts as editable vectors. Not a flattened PDF. Works with any CSS framework. First two pages free, $49 lifetime, no subscription.

records.name: Wilson
records.tagline: AI coworker in Slack that builds reports, work tools, + more
records.description: Wilson is the AI coworker who lives in your Slack and does the actual work, not advice, finished files. Ask in a thread and he builds the report, dashboard, deck, internal tool, or code, then drops it right back in the chat. He connects to your real everyday tools (Stripe, HubSpot, GitHub, Meta & Google Ads…), pulls the real numbers himself, asks before anything risky, and never trains on your data. Named after a certain volleyball. Far more useful. 🛟

records.name: ClawEase
records.tagline: An AI business operator that books appointments for SMBs.
records.description: Clawease is an AI business operator for SMBs that captures customer inquiries, checks availability, books appointments, and sends confirmations across phone, WhatsApp, and web forms. It helps appointment-driven teams respond faster, reduce admin work, and convert more inquiries into booked appointments.

records.name: Parano.ai
records.tagline: Never miss a competitor's move
records.description: AI-assisted competitive intelligence for teams that play to win. Parano.ai tracks everything your competitors do, then tells you what it means and what to do about it, saving you hours of research every week while educating your whole team on your market.

records.name: Vitrine
records.tagline: Turn any photo into a beautiful wallpaper
records.description: Vitrine lets you turn any photo into a fluted-glass desktop wallpaper on Mac. Drop in an image and refract it through vertical glass ribs for a textured look. It renders live with Metal so you see results instantly, then export at full resolution and set it as your desktop. With a simple drag-and-drop workflow, you can quickly craft unique wallpapers from your photos.

records.name: Redactify
records.tagline: Automated profanity censoring for video & audio
records.description: Bleep out swear words in your videos automatically, and blur speakers' mouths so nothing slips through. Built for creators, podcasters, and media teams shipping to TikTok, YouTube, Twitch and Spotify.

records.name: Typerino
records.tagline: Screenwriting and playwriting for movies, television, stage.
records.description: Industry-standard screenwriting and stage-play formatting for feature, television, and stage. No Markdown, no syntax: what you type is what gets exported. Mac and Windows. Free 14-day trial, then $11.99/mo, or $99/year.

records.name: Tyto by ai-coustics
records.tagline: Audio insight that predicts voice AI performance
records.description: Tyto is a lightweight model that runs on your audio stream and predicts whether the audio reaching your agent will cause downstream failures. It outputs a single score plus a breakdown across six dimensions: noise, speaker reverb, speaker loudness, interfering speech, background media speech, packet loss. Try it here: https://ai-coustics-tyto-demo--ph.modal.run/

records.name: Infinite
records.tagline: OS runtime unifying GA4, PostHog, + Stripe into a local db
records.description: Your growth data is trapped in too many dashboards that don't talk to each other. Infinite pulls GA4, Meta, PostHog, + Stripe into one place on your own machine. Now you can finally ask one question across your whole stack and connect the dots: how traffic, signups and revenue move together. Data is stored locally + never leaves your machine. Open source, bring your own LLM, use Claude or Codex.

records.name: Daemons by Charlie Labs
records.tagline: Keep PRs, issues, CI, and docs moving with AI agents
records.description: Charlie Labs gives engineering teams always-on AI daemons that keep work moving after coding agents create it. Define recurring roles in your repo, then let Daemons monitor PRs, issues, CI, docs, and Sentry errors over time. Instead of waiting for another human prompt, Daemons leave reviewable updates where your team already works: GitHub, Linear, Slack, and Sentry.

records.name: TapSign
records.tagline: Send, sign & manage documents easily
records.description: TapSign stands out by removing the biggest pain point in eSignature tools: ongoing subscriptions. Unlike most platforms that lock users into monthly fees, TapSign offers optional lifetime access so businesses can pay once and own their document workflow long-term. It combines legally binding eSignatures, real-time tracking, audit trails, team collaboration, and secure storage in one simple dashboard, making document signing faster, more affordable, and more ownership-focused.

records.name: StraVIBE
records.tagline: Strava for vibe coders
records.description: Track your AI coding usage across Claude, Cursor, Codex and more. Climb the leaderboard.

records.name: Temp-Mail
records.tagline: One-click disposable email, no signup
records.description: Free temporary email service. Get a disposable inbox in one click — no signup, no tracking. Skip spam and protect your real email address.

records.name: Foliko
records.tagline: A minimalist pluggable agent framework
records.description: Foliko - A minimalist, pluggable agent framework that supports multiple AIs, streaming output, and sub-agent systems.

records.name: Shopify AI Product Descriptions
records.tagline: SEO product descriptions for Shopify. Upload CSV, export.
records.description: Upload your product CSV and generate SEO-optimized product descriptions in bulk using AI. Built for Shopify store owners.

records.name: Clinch
records.tagline: Break the scroll. One mindful moment per app open.
records.description: A ~15s mindful moment between you and Instagram, TikTok, and the apps that pull at you — breath, puzzle, fact, rotated so it never gets stale. Then it asks: what brought you here? Pro ($1.99/mo · $14.99/yr · $39.99 lifetime): unlimited apps, all 6 interceptors, Coach (patterns → one-tap blocks), hard-block scheduler. iOS 17+. No account, no cloud — stays on your phone.

records.name: Wolfram Language 15
records.tagline: Computational language built for humans and AI agents
records.description: New and updated functionality in Wolfram Language 15: LLM & AI, notebook & user interfaces, symbolic & numeric computations, visualization & graphics, geometry & graphs, astronomy, chemistry, life sciences, knowledgebase, video, PDEs & system modeling, core language, compiler & evaluation, repositories.

records.name: BrainFlow
records.tagline: Turn your rambling thoughts into coherent notes
records.description: Tap record, say what's on your mind, and get back a real note: clean headings, key points, next steps. No typing, no tidying. Export to Notion or email to yourself.

records.name: DefyTON
records.tagline: Stake crypto on your habits. AI verifies. You earn or lose.
records.description: Habit apps send reminders you ignore. DefyTON makes you put real money on the line. Stake TON on daily challenges in Telegram. Upload a photo as proof — AI verifies it instantly. Hit 100% and get your deposit back plus rewards. Miss days, and lose a portion. What's different: • Deposit real TON as accountability • AI judges your photo proof automatically • No app install — runs in Telegram • Free challenges available — try with zero risk • Pay with Telegram Stars — no wallet needed

records.name: Auto-crossposting from OneUp
records.tagline: Post to main account ➡️ OneUp auto posts it all accounts
records.description: OneUp's cross-posting feature allows you to auto-post FROM one account TO other social accounts. For example: post image or video to Instagram from the IG mobile app ➡️ OneUp auto posts it to all your other accounts

records.name: DescGen India
records.tagline: "Marketplace intelligence for Indian sellers"
records.description: India has crores of ecommerce sellers. Most write listings like "Good product. Nice quality." 😐 That's killing great products silently. DescGen India fixes this — AI marketplace intelligence built specifically for Indian sellers. Generate listings. Preview before publishing. Analyze product images. Optimize for Meesho, Amazon, Flipkart & more. 🇮🇳 Try free → descgen.shop

records.name: CardVault
records.tagline: Intelligent credit card rewards and benefits management.
records.description: Card Vault is an application designed to help users intelligently manage their credit card rewards and benefits. It aims to maximize the value users derive from their credit cards by tracking rewards, identifying optimal spending strategies, and ensuring no benefits are missed.

records.name: Workforce Intelligence Layer
records.tagline: Identify AI opportunities, skills gaps, and Workforce ROI.
records.description: SkillSynch AI (skillsynch.ai) -Most organisations know they need AI. Few know where to deploy it, which jobs will be impacted, what skills will be required, or how to prepare their workforce. SkillSynch AI diagnoses work at the task level, prioritises the highest-value AI opportunities, quantifies workforce impact, and provides a governed sandbox where employees can safely learn, experiment, and adapt.

records.name: NoFlattery
records.tagline: An AI council that argues, instead of agreeing with you.
records.description: NoFlattery is a local-first AI council for hard decisions. Instead of one assistant agreeing with you, agents with different biases debate the trade-off and help produce a Decision Record: verdict, reasoning, main risk, and next step. Bring your own API key; chats and keys stay in your browser. Pay once, no subscription.

records.name: SmartCarAgent
records.tagline: Paste any car listing, get a Deal Score instantly.
records.description: Paste any AutoTrader or CarGurus listing URL and get an instant Deal Score, market comparison, TCO estimate, recall check, AI negotiation report, plus model year depreciation rate and mileage depreciation rate analysis. Make smarter used car buying decisions.

records.name: ApplyedNow
records.tagline: Beat the ATS. Land more interviews. Powered by AI
records.description: Optimize your resume for ATS, find matching jobs, and get your LinkedIn reviewed by real HR professionals. Land your dream job faster with ApplyedNow.

records.name: The Multi OS Orchestration
records.tagline: product discovery
records.description: K-denceAI is the ultimate AI Operating System built to unify your entire ecosystem

records.name: FinTrack
records.tagline: Make your finances simple and efficient
records.description: FinTrack — a budgeting app designed for your convenience and to save your time. Facts about FinTrack: Thought-out economic model. Artificial intelligence: scans receipts via camera or from the gallery and automatically fills in the data. Core features are available in one click. Cross-platform support: web version and mobile app.

records.name: Cluegent
records.tagline: Your personalized AI co-pilot for live interviews.
records.description: Cluegent is a private AI interview assistant for real-time answers, coding help, screenshot-aware support, Zoom, Meet, Teams, and Windows desktop workflows.

records.name: AuraIntel
records.tagline: The invisible, screen-share safe AI coding assistant
records.description: AuraIntel is a stealth desktop overlay that solves coding problems in real-time. Designed to be completely invisible on Zoom/Teams/Discord screen shares, it captures problems, generates optimized code, and auto-types solutions directly at your cursor.

records.name: Pixel Oracle
records.tagline: Type anything, get art. Free AI images, no sign-up walls
records.description: Pixel Oracle turns words into images in seconds, with zero friction. No account, no credit card, no waitlist: open it in your browser, type what you imagine, pick from 12 styles, hit Generate Magic. Most AI image tools demand a sign-up before you see anything. Pixel Oracle generates immediately, free, every day. Want more? A single $5 lifetime unlock, no subscription. Runs in any browser, plus Windows and Android apps. Built by a solo founder at CMK Sons Labs.

records.name: Renzo
records.tagline: Know who to contact. Know what to say.
records.description: Most outreach tools are built for cold email. Renzo is built for the relationships you already have. Connect your CRM or import a CSV. Renzo scores your contacts by priority — who is overdue, whose contract is expiring, who you haven't spoken to in too long. One click generates a personalized message that sounds like you wrote it. No sequences. No templates. No cold email. Just warm, human outreach at scale. Credit-based pricing — pay only for what you use.

records.name: Parley
records.tagline: Investor-owned AI agents qualify startups for intro calls.
records.description: Investors deploy AI agents and give them the access to schedule intro-calls. Founders pitch those agents instead of chasing warm intros or cold emails. The agent can ask questions, request materials, and qualify the startup on behalf of the investor. Unlike email inboxes, every conversation on Parley must be resolved. The outcome is always one of two things: a call/intro with the investor or a clear explanation of why there isn't a fit. Parley is the intake layer between founders and investors

records.name: FindNest: Ai Item Store&Find
records.tagline: Store items by photo or voice. Find anything fast with AI
records.description: FindNest is an AI-powered smart home organizer & inventory tracker built to end the frustration of losing track of your belongings. What you can do: • AI Photo Input: Snap a photo, and AI automatically tags & categorizes your items. • Smart AI Search: Just ask "Where is my passport?" and find it instantly. • Box Tracking: Generate & print QR codes for storage boxes. Scan to see inside without opening. • Voice Command: Record and update items by simply talking.

records.name: kidsit.ai
records.tagline: AI parenting coach for the hardest 10 minutes of your day
records.description: Press and hold a mic, tell Kidsit AI what just happened with your kid, and get back 3 specific things to try — including the exact words to say. Grounded in Ginott / Faber-Mazlish parenting research. No lectures. iOS. Free to try with 1 kid.

records.name: ThreadScout
records.tagline: Daily Reddit threads where your ICP describes the pain
records.description: Solo founders get told "engage on Reddit" — then waste an hour hunting for the right thread and risk getting flagged as spam. ThreadScout fixes the hunting part: → Tell it what you sell + your pain phrases + subreddits → Every day it surfaces new posts where someone describes that exact pain → Each thread gets a relevance score (1–10) and a value-first reply draft — not "buy my SaaS" First digest free if you comment below with your product + 2 subreddits.

records.name: Askio.cloud
records.tagline: AI command center for infrastructure operations
records.description: Manage server inventory, monitoring, browser access, approvals, and Ops resources with Askio's AI infrastructure command center.

records.name: VocoSafe AI
records.tagline: Private, 100% offline AI dictation for Mac
records.description: Free to download. Turn speech into text entirely on your Mac. VocoSafe AI runs open-source models like Whisper, NVIDIA Parakeet and SenseVoice on-device — no cloud, no telemetry. Core dictation and transcription are always free; PRO adds AI voice activation and AI grammar.

records.name: Weaver
records.tagline: Home Repair, Made Simple
records.description: Something broke? Weave it. Weaver helps homeowners identify repair issues, understand costs, find qualified contractors, and move from problem to solution in minutes—not hours. Free.

records.name: Dummy JSON Generator | JSONForge
records.tagline: Privacy-first dummy JSON generator for upto 1M records.
records.description: Generate customizable dummy JSON data instantly with JSONForge. Perfect for testing, mock APIs, and rapid prototyping. JSONForge is a high-performance, browser-only data generator for developers. Unlike server-based tools, it runs entirely in your browser sandbox, ensuring total privacy. Generate up to 1,000,000 records of realistic JSON, CSV, or SQL data instantly—no signup, no rate limits, and 100% free. Perfect for testing, prototyping, and load-testing.

records.name: LevelUp AI coach
records.tagline: Level up your body, beauty, and nutrition with AI
records.description: LevelUp AI combines fitness, beauty, and nutrition into one AI-powered coach. Users can scan their body and face, receive personalized workout and meal recommendations, track daily habits, maintain streaks, and monitor progress over time. Unlike traditional fitness apps, LevelUp AI brings together body analysis, skincare insights, nutrition guidance, and gamified progress tracking to help users build healthier habits and stay motivated.

records.name: Mosey Tour Builder
records.tagline: Your personal walking tour guide, built on the fly
records.description: Mosey builds a custom walking tour of anywhere on the spot, from your interests, within your mileage budget. Pick a starting point, set how far you want to walk, and choose interests (history, architecture, food, public art, hidden gems). Mosey routes real Google Places stops, plays Wikipedia narration aloud as you arrive, and works a restaurant into the route. No account, no sign-up.. your location never leaves your device. Free to start (3 lifetime tours); Pro is $2.99/mo or $19.99/yr.

records.name: Polygram Coding Agent
records.tagline: AI-native coding assistant that helps developers in any IDE
records.description: Polygram IDE Agent is an AI-native coding assistant that helps developers plan, design, code, and edit products directly inside their IDE. Unlike traditional coding assistants, Polygram uses intelligent multi-agent workflows and smart model routing to dynamically select the best AI models and agents for maximum token efficiency, speed, and output quality. It plugs directly into VS Code, Cursor, and Antigravity along with visual editor for frontend developers.

records.name: SapotKu
records.tagline: The Creator Support Platform Made In Malaysia
records.description: SapotKu helps Malaysian creators receive support directly from their community. Creators can accept donations, sell memberships, receive virtual gifts, display OBS live alerts, and grow through a dedicated creator directory. Features include: • Direct creator support • Monthly memberships • Virtual gifts and leaderboards • OBS live alerts • Creator discovery directory • AI Creator Studio tools Built for streamers, content creators, gamers, educators, and communities across Malaysia.

records.name: Android 17
records.tagline: Android becomes an intelligence system
records.description: Android 17 brings AppFunctions, Android MCP, adaptive-first app requirements, App Bubbles, Continue On, stronger privacy controls, memory limits, performance improvements, and new media/camera APIs as Android starts shifting from an operating system into an intelligence system.

records.name: FieldScout - Offline Survival App
records.tagline: When the grid goes down, this app goes with you.
records.description: FieldScout is a native mobile app with 205 survival articles, offline maps, mesh radio communications, encrypted document vault, and emergency checklists. Works without internet or cell service. By Prepper.blog.

records.name: Anyrisks
records.tagline: UK risk assessments in 60 seconds, not 60 minutes
records.description: Most risk assessments take hours — templates, guessing at hazards, hoping you're legally covered. Anyrisks flips that. Describe your job in plain English and the AI generates a fully compliant, HSE-standard risk assessment in under 60 seconds. Live checks include: EA flood risk, weather, CDM 2015, HSE injury stats, nearest A&E, venue intel, and local events — all built into your document. Built for UK contractors, sole traders, event organisers, and small businesses.

records.name: noProbs
records.tagline: Faceless app for meeting people through shared interests
records.description: noprobs is a faceless matching app that helps people connect beyond profile pictures. Instead of judging by looks, users match through personality, shared values, and real conversation - making it easier to build genuine connections.

records.name: Swipe Loan
records.tagline: India's AI loan marketplace -100+ lenders,zero CIBIL impact.
records.description: SwipeLoan's AI matches you with 100+ RBI-registered lenders for a personal loan up to ₹1,00,000 — in minutes. Compare free. No CIBIL impact.

records.name: RGE Studio
records.tagline: Where really good emails get made.

records.description: In India, most shared flats hire a cook who comes daily. But nobody coordinates — the cook calls one flatmate every morning asking what to make, and groceries run out with no one tracking them. KitchenOS is a AI WhatsApp bot that sits between flatmates and their cook. Flatmates text or voice-note meals. Cook receives the meal plan as text + voice note in Hindi, Kannada, or English. Cook voice-notes when groceries run low — items parsed, everyone notified. No app. Just WhatsApp. Free.
